facts.value: This page is for individuals from/residing in EU/EFTA/UK countries who wish to undertake a full degree at University of Limerick.

facts.value: EU applicants are considered in competition with Irish school leavers. Consequently, offers cannot be issued until Round 1 offers after the Irish Leaving Certificate results are released.

facts.value: Eligible applicants remain on the waiting list and may be offered in order of merit in later rounds, in accordance with CAO procedures.
